complaints.title: Sea Water Inundation in Marina Lowlands
complaints.description: Seawater surge crossing high tide line. 25 huts inundated.

complaints.title: Deep Structural Shear Cracks and Concrete Spalling on Arterial Flyover Pillar 14
complaints.description: Following high-velocity flood currents, visible vertical structural shear cracks observed across Pillar 14 of the river bridge. Vibration felt under heavy vehicular transit.
complaints.location: Adyar River Bridge, Kotturpuram Connecting Spur
complaints.resolutionNotes: PWD structural engineering inspection executed on Oct 24. Emergency epoxy grouting and steel jacketing completed. Traffic certified safe at 30 km/h.
complaints.feedbackComments: Incredible speed by PWD engineers. Inspected within 2 hours and completed stabilization before the cyclone made landfall.

complaints.title: Massive Tree Debris & Construction Silt Completely Choking Main Stormwater Drain
complaints.description: Stormwater canal outlet towards the river is 90% blocked by collapsed trees and plastic construction waste. Water backflowing onto main arterial highway, threatening to cut off ambulance access to the district hospital.
complaints.resolutionNotes: Heavy hydraulic excavator and 200 HP dewatering pumps allocated. Team scheduled to arrive in 30 minutes.

complaints.title: Submerged 11kV Power Transformer Sparking in Floodwater Outside Densely Populated Colony
complaints.description: An 11kV street transformer pillar is partially submerged in water following torrential downpours. Loud electrical arcing and sparks observed continuously. High risk of fatal electrocution to pedestrians and rescue personnel.
complaints.location: T. Nagar, South Usman Road, near Ranganathan Street Junction
complaints.resolutionNotes: TNEB Grid sub-station alerted. Remote trip signal sent to isolate Feeder 4. Line repair team en route with insulation poles.

complaints.title: Torrential Flash Flood Waterlogging (4.5 Feet Water) Trapping 40+ Resident Families
complaints.description: Due to torrential monsoon downpour and canal breach, storm water has submerged the ground floor of residential apartments on Velachery Bypass Road. Water level is rapidly rising above 4 feet. Children, elderly citizens, and patients need immediate inflatable boat evacuation to high ground shelter.
complaints.location: Velachery Bypass Road, near Guru Nanak College Gate 2
complaints.resolutionNotes: NDRF 4th Battalion Team Alpha dispatched with 4 motorized Gemini inflatable rescue boats, life jackets, and trauma medics. Evacuation underway towards Anna University Shelter.

alerts.title: RED ALERT: SEVERE CYCLONIC STORM 'VARUNA' APPROACHING COAST
alerts.message: IMD & Disaster Management Authority Alert: Severe Cyclone 'VARUNA' will make landfall within 18 hours with 130 km/h wind gusts and heavy storm surges. Public in coastal and low-lying zones must evacuate immediately to designated High-Ground Relief Shelters (Nehru Stadium, YMCA, Anna University). Avoid travel, keep emergency kits ready.
alerts.issuedBy: State Relief Commissioner Dr. K. Radhakrishnan (IAS)
